subject: Rename ValkeySearch to valkey-search (#119)
reason: The change is purely cosmetic: it renames 'ValkeySearch' to 'valkey-search' in copyright headers, LICENSE, QUICK_START.md and the CMake project() name, plus a few clang-format whitespace fixes (ternary spacing in vector_base.cc, brace spacing in tag.h, indentation in status_builder.h and valkey_module.h). No command handling, parsing, indexing, serialization, replication or reply code changes semantically; the compiled module behaves identically at the change and its parent, so there is no behavior for a scenario to reach.
